criteria.description: Before replacing a canonical 30004 SBOM availability list, Bahia subscribes to the current list using a scoped REQ for kind 30004 with #d, #subject, and #subject_type.
criteria.verification: TestSBOMOrchestratorMergesRelayAvailabilityBeforeReplacement asserts kind, d, subject, and subject_type filter scope.

criteria.description: Relay EVENT content is trusted only after event ID, signature, required tags, and SBOM availability entries validate.
criteria.verification: TestSBOMOrchestratorRejectsInvalidRelayAvailabilityContent rejects invalid relay list content before publication.

criteria.description: Historical catch-up waits for EOSE before publishing the replacement list and fails closed on CLOSED before EOSE.
criteria.verification: TestSBOMOrchestratorFailsClosedWhenAvailabilitySubscriptionClosesBeforeEOSE ensures no 30004 publish or projection occurs after CLOSED before EOSE.

criteria.description: Relay entries and local projection entries are merged without dropping valid existing references.
criteria.verification: TestSBOMOrchestratorMergesRelayAvailabilityBeforeReplacement asserts the replacement list contains both local and relay entries.

criteria.description: AUTH, EVENT, RelayEOSE, EOSE, CLOSED, and OK paths are deterministic and tested without sleeps.
criteria.verification: Scripted fake subscription injects AUTH, RelayEOSE, EVENT, EOSE, and CLOSED messages; fake publisher injects OK results.
